runtimeScope: P2 is third-party LGPLv3-path proof infrastructure because the reviewed build uses --enable-version3. It is not a selected shipping runtime, public-distribution approval, or approval to use every component compiled into the archive.
componentSelectionPolicy: Every command must explicitly select or record every concrete demuxer, decoder, encoder, muxer, filter, and stream selector used. Presence is not semantic proof.
deliveryPolicy: WebM VP9/Opus is an open-delivery proof candidate only, not the final ReelForge default.

acceptance: JSON parses
stream count and order match authored truths
container time bases are recorded and normalized presentation timestamps match authored timing truths
F8 selectors identify distinguishable streams
select frame ordinal 1
decoded rgb24 bytes equal authored f1-pattern-001 pixels
no extra frame is emitted
decoded frames equal authored frames 1 and 2 in order
decoded PCM equals the authored interleaved sample slice
output timestamps start at zero and are monotonic
both inputs are explicitly normalized
concat succeeds only after normalization
six decoded frames span both authored visual identities
A/V timestamps start at zero, remain monotonic, and cross the 120 ms boundary without a backwards jump
decoded samples equal the independently summed and int16-clamped source samples within tolerance
both source frequencies remain present
duration and sample count match
crop and scale place the alpha overlay in the declared region
opaque regions retain authored colors
alpha blend matches independently calculated source-over color within tolerance
brightness, contrast, and saturation each execute as separate deterministic visual/oracle tests using the approved filters
repeated output hashes match for each deterministic basic-color operation
cross-dissolve contains an intermediate blend and reaches both authored endpoints
dip-to/from-black contains a black midpoint and returns to the authored endpoint
frame count and timestamps are deterministic
exact output byte length matches geometry
known tone output has independently bounded wave pixels
digital-silence output has no wave excursion
tone and silence outputs differ
repeated execution against identical input produces the same SHA-256
proxy dimensions do not exceed the declared draft target
display aspect is preserved by scale/pad
paired inspection confirms VP9/Opus WebM
explicit decode-again succeeds
paired inspection matches the declared structure
explicit VP9 and Opus decode-again succeeds
decoded frame identities/order remain distinguishable
visual error stays within the declared proof tolerance
composition normalization/concat semantics survive delivery encoding
paired inspection and explicit decode-again succeed
both segment visual identities remain present in order
FLAC decode equals authored PCM bytes
Ogg Opus inspection and explicit decode-again succeed
Opus output preserves duration and channel count, and 1000 Hz remains stronger than the declared comparison frequencies

actual title/caption rendering uses inventory-bound logical/layout/ASS inputs
fixed-geometry wrapping and title/caption safe regions are independently measured
Arabic ass shaping=complex output is distinct from the simple shaping control
complex output repeat SHA-256 matches the reviewed golden
missing-CJK negative control rejects ambient fallback
actual playback from local file and HTTP where relevant
open and seek
pause and resume
A/V synchronization
end-of-file behavior
exact player, OS, and codec-pack state recorded
capabilities.boundary: Paired FFmpeg inspection and decode-again cannot satisfy this requirement. macOS remains research evidence only.

timestamps remain monotonic through the final segment
first and final authored identities match
